title: Two Models That Agree Beat the Best of Them Alone: Parameter-Free Connected-Component Consensus That Beats the Baseline under the Official BraTS-2023 Metrics
description: Version 10 (2026-09-22) — first deposit of the v10 revision. It carries the result-first title 'Two Models That Agree Beat the Best of Them Alone: Parameter-Free Connected-Component Consensus That Beats the Baseline under the Official BraTS-2023 Metrics', both authors (Guillaume Cassez first, Stanislas Larnier second), full English/French manuscript parity (30 sections, 9 figures, identical table counts), and the multi-seed robustness tables of §4.6 reported from the complete, fragment-cleaned evaluation run (n = 720 valid pairs; data/multiseed/stats.json, md5 fe5d513e563a0bc946db983c93e8013f — the numbers published since v7), cross-checked cell by cell by scripts/check_5_6_provenance.py. Two corrections were measured on 2026-09-22 after an external audit of the v9 supplement. (1) Vocabulary: a false positive is no longer called a 'hallucination' — a term that, in the generative-model literature, names a different phenomenon — but a spurious (false-positive) connected component; §1 states the choice explicitly and the word survives only where the text rejects it. (2) Dataset provenance: the study set is 1196 of the 1251 downloaded cases, and the 55 dropped cases are listed one by one — trigger, git date of the triggering entry, file-integrity re-measurement — in analysis/DATASET_EXCLUSIONS.md (EN) and analysis/DATASET_EXCLUSIONS_fr.md (FR), with their artifacts: analysis/exclusions_1251_to_1196.csv|json, analysis/integrite_exclus_vs_temoins.csv|json (55 excluded cases vs 55 included controls: 0 unreadable file, 0 NaN/Inf, 0 out-of-set label, 0 divergent affine), analysis/sonde_5_cas_exacts.json, analysis/comparaison_3_copies.tsv (byte-identical across the three surviving copies) and analysis/folds.csv (disjoint 5-fold patient split, 240/239/239/239/239). The exclusion is a patient-level precaution recorded in March 2026, upstream of every training run and every metric; no published number changes. The archive bundles the FR + EN manuscripts (markdown and PDF, 25 and 23 pages), the 9 figures, the analysis and data artifacts, the demonstration patients C1-C6 re-selected on 2026-08-31, and build.sh, a self-contained pandoc + XeLaTeX recipe that recompiles both PDFs from the shipped sources.
notes: Companion Paper 2 (Kervadec boundary loss) studies the precision end of the same recall–precision axis. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19695263 resolves to the latest version; this record is v10 (previous published version: v9, 2026-07-03, 10.5281/zenodo.21168405, single author and previous title).
